info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Drafts Retrieval API
info.description: The Bank Drafts Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about specific bank drafts. This endpoint allows developers to query for bank draft data, providing essential insights for consumers and financial institutions. Typical use cases include verifying draft authenticity or retrieving historical transaction details. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their banking services and consumer offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve bank draft details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific bank draft using its unique identifier. It provides comprehensive information related to the bank draft such as its status, associated amount, and other relevant metadata.
